description: Eight questions covering every document in the corpus. Each question lists the source file(s) that contain the evidence, which lets retrieval quality be scored automatically by Hit@k and MRR.

questions.question: What is retrieval-augmented generation and what problem does it address?
What is FAISS used for in this system, and why was IndexFlatIP chosen?
Why was the BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 model selected as the embedding model?
How does dense retrieval differ from keyword matching such as BM25?
Why does retrieval augmentation reduce hallucination in language models?
How is the prompt constructed in a RAG system, and why are source labels included?
What are the main dimensions used to evaluate a RAG system?
What stages does the offline indexing pipeline include, and why are chunks overlapped?
